content.short: Discover Ritual, a highly optimized Blockchains protocol focusing on layer 1 blockchains (l1s) to drive mass adoption in Web3.
content.description: Ritual is a decentralized AI computing network that aims to democratize access to AI infrastructure and models through Web3 technologies. By leveraging the underlying security and performance of the Ethereum network(s), Ritual aims to deliver a robust and scalable solution for its users. The project offers a suite of decentralized tools tailored for layer 1 blockchains (l1s), ensuring transparent and trustless operations. As the Web3 landscape continues to evolve, Ritual is positioning itself as a core infrastructure component to empower builders and end-users alike, bridging the gap between traditional architectures and decentralized networks.
content.meta: Ritual provides innovative layer 1 blockchains (l1s) tools for the Blockchains space. Discover Ritual and other decentralized applications on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
